fields.Name: Collaboration: Visible Spaces
fields.Description: A space the caller owns, a space their active membership reaches, or the one space a magic-link scope names. Parenthesised so it ANDs onto any other filter the caller holds. TRY_CAST so a missing user id matches nothing instead of raising a conversion error.
fields.FilterText: (OwnerID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) OR ID IN (SELECT SpaceID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER))) OR CAST(ID AS NVARCHAR(450)) = '{{ScopeResourceID}}')

fields.Name: Collaboration: Visible Members
fields.Description: The caller's own roster rows, active seats on spaces they reach, and invited or removed seats where their reaching role can invite.
fields.FilterText: ((Status = N'Active' AND SpaceID IN (SELECT SpaceID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)))) OR UserID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) OR (Status IN (N'Invited', N'Removed') AND SpaceID IN (SELECT SpaceID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)) WHERE CanInvite = 1)))

fields.Name: Collaboration: Visible Items
fields.Description: Shared items in a visible space, team items only when the reaching role has CanSeeTeamBand, and shared items in the one space a magic link names.
fields.FilterText: ((SpaceID IN (SELECT SpaceID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)) WHERE CanSeeTeam = 1) OR (Band = N'Shared' AND SpaceID IN (SELECT SpaceID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER))))) OR (Band = N'Shared' AND CAST(SpaceID AS NVARCHAR(450)) = '{{ScopeResourceID}}'))

fields.Name: Collaboration: Active Space Types
fields.Description: Space types are vocabulary, not content. Active types are readable. The filter is present so the role is not exempt from row-level security.
fields.FilterText: (IsActive = 1)

fields.Name: Collaboration: Active Space Roles
fields.Description: Role types are the flags the engine reads. Active roles are readable. The filter is present so the role is not exempt from row-level security.
fields.FilterText: (IsActive = 1)

fields.Name: Collaboration: Shell Empty
fields.Description: Present and empty. A participant can boot the shell without reading core rows.

fields.Name: Collaboration: Own User
fields.Description: The caller's own user row.
fields.FilterText: (ID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER))

fields.Name: Collaboration: Own User Child
fields.Description: Rows owned by the caller, keyed UserID.
fields.FilterText: (UserID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER))

fields.Name: Collaboration: All Application Roles
fields.Description: Application role rows name which role may open which app. The filter is present so the participant is not exempt from row-level security.

fields.Name: Collaboration: Conversations In Reach
fields.Description: Conversations bound to a space the caller reaches.
fields.FilterText: (LinkedEntityID = '3648DC35-1DC4-4ED6-A1A6-5D87271A54DB' AND LinkedRecordID IN (SELECT CONVERT(nvarchar(36), SpaceID) FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER))))

fields.Name: Collaboration: Conversation Details In Reach
fields.Description: Details whose conversation is bound to a space the caller reaches.
fields.FilterText: (ConversationID IN (SELECT ID FROM [__mj].[Conversation] WHERE LinkedEntityID = '3648DC35-1DC4-4ED6-A1A6-5D87271A54DB' AND LinkedRecordID IN (SELECT CONVERT(nvarchar(36), SpaceID) FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)))))

fields.Name: Collaboration: Files In Reach
fields.Description: Files whose canonical RecordID is a Shared or visible Team item in a space the caller reaches.
fields.FilterText: ((N'ID|' + CONVERT(nvarchar(36), ID)) IN (SELECT i.RecordID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[SpaceItem] AS i WHERE i.EntityID = '29248F34-2837-EF11-86D4-6045BDEE16E6' AND ((i.Band = N'Shared' AND i.SpaceID IN (SELECT SpaceID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)))) OR i.SpaceID IN (SELECT SpaceID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)) WHERE CanSeeTeam = 1))))

fields.Name: Collaboration: Notices For The Caller
fields.Description: Share notices addressed to the caller, in spaces they reach.
fields.FilterText: (RecipientUserID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) AND SpaceID IN (SELECT SpaceID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER))))

fields.Name: Collaboration: Own Item Uses
fields.Description: The caller's own item uses, in spaces they reach.
fields.FilterText: (UserID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) AND SpaceID IN (SELECT SpaceID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER))))

fields.Name: Collaboration: Notices The Caller May Send
fields.Description: A new notice is in a space the caller reaches, and it is not addressed to the caller.
fields.FilterText: (RecipientUserID <> TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) AND SpaceID IN (SELECT SpaceID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER))))

fields.Name: Collaboration: Own Workspace Items
fields.Description: Items in a workspace the caller owns.
fields.FilterText: (WorkspaceID IN (SELECT ID FROM [__mj].[Workspace] WHERE UserID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)))

fields.Name: Collaboration: Tasks In Reach
fields.Description: Tasks filed in a space the caller reaches, and the tasks under them.
fields.FilterText: (ID IN (SELECT TaskID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationTasks](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER))))

fields.Name: Collaboration: Task Rows In Reach
fields.Description: Rows whose task is one the caller can see.
fields.FilterText: (TaskID IN (SELECT TaskID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationTasks](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER))))

fields.Name: Collaboration: Subtasks Under A Writable Parent
fields.Description: A subtask whose parent the caller can write. Roots are filed by the server.
fields.FilterText: (ParentID IN (SELECT TaskID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationTasks](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)) WHERE CanWrite = 1))

fields.Name: Collaboration: Task Catalog
fields.Description: Task types, roles, and templates. No row of the caller's work.

fields.Name: Collaboration: Tasks The Caller May Change
fields.Description: A filed root stays parentless. Any other task needs a writable parent.
fields.FilterText: (ID IN (SELECT TaskID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationTasks](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)) WHERE CanWrite = 1) AND ((ID IN (SELECT TaskID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationTasks](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)) WHERE IsRoot = 1) AND ParentID IS NULL) OR (ID NOT IN (SELECT TaskID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationTasks](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)) WHERE IsRoot = 1) AND ParentID IN (SELECT TaskID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationTasks](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)) WHERE CanWrite = 1))))

fields.Name: Collaboration: Task Rows A Contributor May Change
fields.Description: A row of a task the caller can write.
fields.FilterText: (TaskID IN (SELECT TaskID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationTasks](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)) WHERE CanWrite = 1))

fields.Name: Collaboration: Task Dependencies In Reach
fields.Description: Both ends of the dependency are tasks the caller can see.
fields.FilterText: (TaskID IN (SELECT TaskID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationTasks](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER))) AND DependsOnTaskID IN (SELECT TaskID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationTasks](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER))))

fields.Name: Collaboration: Task Dependencies A Contributor May Change
fields.Description: Both ends are tasks the caller can write.
fields.FilterText: (TaskID IN (SELECT TaskID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationTasks](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)) WHERE CanWrite = 1) AND DependsOnTaskID IN (SELECT TaskID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationTasks](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)) WHERE CanWrite = 1))

fields.Name: Collaboration: Task Comments The Author May Change
fields.Description: The caller wrote the comment, on a task they can write.
fields.FilterText: ((TaskID IN (SELECT TaskID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationTasks](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)) WHERE CanWrite = 1)) AND (PersonID IN (SELECT ID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCommon].[Person] WHERE LinkedUserID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER))))

fields.Name: Collaboration: People In Reach
fields.Description: The caller's own person, and people linked to a user with an active seat on a space the caller reaches.
fields.FilterText: (LinkedUserID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) OR LinkedUserID IN (SELECT m.UserID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[SpaceMember] AS m WHERE m.Status = N'Active' AND m.SpaceID IN (SELECT SpaceID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)))))
